personajes.en: Weathered mestizo farmer with ruddy wind-burned cheeks, short gray hair under a dark felt hat, thick beige wool ruana over a checked flannel shirt and jeans, tall black rubber boots, holding a small sack of seed potatoes.

Stout campesina with warm brown skin, gray hair pulled into a low bun, layered blouse and dark apron over a long skirt, flat-soled shoes, colorful plastic market bags, holding a scale with fresh green herbs and leafy vegetables.
Young mestizo man with olive skin and black hair under a worn cap, blue waterproof jacket over a sweater, rubber boots speckled with mud, steel milk can in one gloved hand, rope-wrapped wrist.

Slender teacher with straight dark hair in a ponytail, medium brown skin, simple knit cardigan over a blouse, tailored trousers, low-heeled shoes, canvas satchel across her shoulder, holding notebooks and a marker.

Slim teenage boy with straight black hair, light brown skin, school uniform of navy sweater over white shirt and dark trousers, scuffed sneakers, backpack with straps, a plastic water bottle in hand, walking along a dirt road.

Indigenous-descended woman with dark copper-brown skin, high cheekbones, long braided black hair, painted apron over blouse and skirt, worn sandals, clay-stained hands, holding a small terracotta ceramic pot she just shaped.

Elderly thin man with deep wrinkles, white mustache, pale brown skin, faded olive ruana over a shirt, brown felt hat, worn leather shoes, wooden walking cane, small cloth coin pouch tied at his waist.

Strong mestizo worker with tan skin, short black hair, yellow safety helmet, reflective orange vest over sweatshirt and work jeans, heavy boots with white cement dust stains, holding a masonry trowel, bandana around his neck.
